items.title: Summarise a meeting
items.prompt: Summarise the attached meeting notes in three bullet points.
items.output:
- The launch moves to **next Tuesday**.
- Design owns the final copy review.
- Support needs the FAQ by Friday.
items.reference: Launch moved to Tuesday; design reviews copy; support needs the FAQ by Friday.

items.title: Answer a policy question
items.prompt: Can I expense a train ticket for a client visit?
items.output: Yes. Travel for client visits is reimbursable with a receipt, up to the standard fare.

items.title: Draft a reply
items.prompt: Draft a short, polite reply declining the invitation.
items.output: Thank you for the invitation. Unfortunately I can’t join this time, but I hope it goes well.

rubric.label: Accuracy
rubric.description: Facts match the source or reference.
